heading: Persons entitled to passport
lead: No passport shall be granted or issued to or verified for any other persons than those owing allegiance, whether citizens or not, to the United States.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: R.S. § 4076 derived from act May 30, 1866, ch. 102, 14 Stat. 54.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1902—Act June 14, 1902, substituted “those owing allegiance, whether citizens or not, to the United States” for “citizens of the United States”.
